import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """ {title}

{title}

{body}
""" def render_article_page(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Formats and sanitizes a blog post for safe HTML display. Args: headline (str): The title of the blog post. content (str): The full text content of the blog post. Returns: str: A complete HTML page string with the title and body inserted safely. """ # Escape any special characters to prevent XSS or HTML injection safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Inject the escaped values into the template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
